## File: facebookresearch_ego4d/ego4d/egoexo/scripts/extract_audio_transcribe.py

Prompts

```
['run the script to extract audio from VRS files and transcribe with Whisper large-v3 model', 'run process_all to transcribe a batch of VRS video takes using Whisper on CUDA', 'run extract_audio_and_run_whisper to extract audio from a single VRS file and save transcriptions as JSON', 'refactor main to accept argparse arguments for root_dir, out_dir, and num_machines instead of hardcoded values', 'review extract_audio_and_run_whisper to understand how it extracts audio tracks and runs Whisper transcription with word timestamps']
```
